_README: Scout's editable filter lists. The effective config has THREE layers:
2. THIS FILE — a key REPLACES the built-in list, a key prefixed with '+'
APPENDS to it (usually what you want for exclusions). Re-read when
this file's mtime changes, so no redeploy is needed.
3. the scout_filter_overrides table — the 'never exclude this' buttons
on /scout/roles -> Excluded. Applied as a DELTA on top of this file,
so editing here still takes effect and those corrections ride over
it. They live in the database because Railway's filesystem is
ephemeral; undo them under 'Allowed' on that same screen.
Put a rule you want in version control HERE. Use the buttons for one-off
corrections while you are reading the exclusion log.
Run scripts/scout_coverage_baseline.py after editing: the report prints
'excluded: N' with every dropped listing and its reason, so an over-eager
_filters_note: gov.uk's own filter field names, verified against the live site:
Distance must be one of 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, all.
_watchlist_note: Employers whose listings are never silently dropped by the standard rule;
they surface in the report's 'review' group instead. Replace this with your
spreadsheet's employers — it overrides the built-in list entirely.
